title: Orquestrador: schema estrito compativel com Codex e diagnostico estruturado preservado
description:
Derived Codex compatibility fix for the read-only conversational orchestrator.

In src/runtime/conversational-orchestrator.ts, make ORCHESTRATOR_RESULT_SCHEMA valid for strict Structured Outputs without creating provider-specific schemas. The command object must list every declared property in required. Keep type as the existing enum; represent every conditionally unused string field (title, scope, verificationCommand, reason, issueId, runId, guidance) as string-or-null. Add one concise prompt rule that unused command fields are null. Keep parseOrchestratorResponse as the semantic gate: commands that need a value still require a nonblank string, type none ignores null extras, and the public OrchestratorCommand union remains unchanged.

In src/runtime/codex-cli-executor.ts, when the JSONL stream supplied a turn.failed or error message, surface state.failed before falling back to the generic nonzero-exit diagnostic. This preserves the provider diagnostic when stderr is empty and changes no successful path or retry policy.

Extend test/runtime/conversational-orchestrator.test.ts to pin the strict schema shape and null behavior, including rejection when a command-required field is null. Extend test/runtime/codex-cli-executor.test.ts with a fixture failure that exits nonzero after a structured error and assert the structured diagnostic wins over the empty stderr fallback.

Out of scope: provider-specific schema branches, changing the command union, retries, model selection, UI, cache deletion, or new dependencies.
